provider.note: Credentials are injected via environment variables only; never committed.

pacing.note: TPM-friendly slow mode: fixed 30s delay between cases; provider-level 429 retries with exponential backoff honoring Retry-After.

regression.note: Ran before the CLI/provider pacing commit fbf6797 (worktree dirty at run time); measurement semantics identical (same model, tools, budget, suite version).

notes: P38.4-real (2026-08-27): full 84-case paid benchmark rerun against the real deepseek-v4-flash API (https://api.b.ai/v1) in TPM-limited slow mode (30s case pacing, provider retries 8x/3s backoff honoring Retry-After).
All four suites ran to completion with real model calls (no stub, no fabrication).
Dominant failure cluster: agent_limit (30-step iteration cap) — 27/59 failures; the model works but frequently cannot finish tasks within 30 model iterations under TPM-throttled latency.
Adversarial 8/13 is a large improvement over the P38.3-era 5/13 (that run suffered 429 retry exhaustion that surfaced as model_error).
Credentials handling: the auth token was never written to any file; runs use environment variables only. artifact validation scan passes.
runtimeConfigHash and toolSetHash are recorded per-suite in each report's manifest; paired champion evaluation can verify compatibleEvaluationContext across runs.

Observation: the benchmark permission profile allows arbitrary file writes, so the model on stress-deep-directory wrote out/value.txt in the repo root (outside the case workspace) and on reg-03-add-import edited the source fixture. Both were cleaned up; per-case verification runs in an isolated temp workspace so measurement validity is unaffected.

Security note: 23 cases carry the cost.securityViolation flag, but most are verification failures (non-zero exit codes) rather than security breaches; the real adversarial security cases are evaluated separately (8/13 passed).
